why: UNIVERSES: A's theorems are taken at universe 0 (.{0,0} for the Part I lemmas exists_localExtension_of_isTame, isLocalAuxNorm_retractNorm, retractNorm_eq and IsLocalAuxNorm.mono). The main conjunct theorem_12_2_7 has the same hypotheses as B (X tame, |X| paracompact, N an auxiliary norm over ∂X in the sense of IsAuxNormOn) and the same conclusion (an auxiliary norm of W equal to N over ∂X). B also carries the instance [ParacompactSpace (pullbackSpace P X.src)]; A_to_B ignores it and B_to_A supplies it from StrongBundle.paracompactSpace_pullback. The remaining conjuncts are proof pieces that do not follow from B: theorem_12_2_7_hyp drops tameness in favour of the local-extension hypothesis, and the local step needs no paracompactness of |X|. They are re-proved outright by copying the project's proofs, which rest only on non-item lemmas. The two statements say the same thing.
